answer: A concrete defense is quadratic-weighted attestations with slashing: the influence any vouch grants grows with the square root of the voucher's own proven stake, and a link is slashed when the identity it endorsed turns out fake. Ten thousand raven-thin endorsements from brand-new wallets buy an attacker almost nothing, since raw counts stay cheap. Real reputation is jade, valuable as one solid piece rather than gravel, and each honest network acts as its own prism: split a self into shards and the light loses coherence.
